notes.title: 🎄🏎️ Speed into Savings: Super Arcade Racing is 50% Off! 🏎️🎄
notes.notes:
Step into a retro world of high-speed thrills with Super Arcade Racing, now 50% off in Steam's Winter Sale! Unravel a gripping story to save your brother in a world where underground racing rules. With over 60 tracks in 5 retro-styled biomes, each race is a flashback to classic gaming glory.

Customize your vintage ride with endless combinations and upgrades to outshine your rivals. The true charm lies in its local multiplayer – perfect for holiday gatherings. Up to 4 players can compete side-by-side, making it an ideal pick for family fun and friendly rivalries this festive season.

notes.title: Nanuka's Dev Diary #5 - Changing pace
notes.notes:
Hello All!

During the last few weeks we've been focusing on lightening up the puzzle aspect of the game. After a round of playtesting, we are leaning more towards a fast paced experience that privileges action and combat.

If you want to watch the episode #5 of the Development Diary of Nanuka: Secret of the Shattering Moon,  click on the video below.

[previewyoutube=mPrhc72MZAY;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Have you tried our dystopic puzzle platformer, Full Void? Demo available again!
notes.notes:
Dear members of the community of Super Arcade Racing, we are using this space to bring our latest release to your attention: Full Void. It is a gripping 2D cinematic puzzle-platformer set in a dystopian future where AI has taken over humanity. You play as a young teenager, alone in a run-down world, relying only on your hacking skills to survive. 
Like all of our games, Full Void is all handcrafted in pixel art, with a retro vibe and has a thrilling synth soundtrack.

If you'd like to give it a go, we have recently made the demo available again on Steam.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1859580/Full_Void/]Download the demo now[/url]

 If you liked Super Arcade Racing and appreciate our work, we think you might enjoy Full Void. Besides, it is a great game to play around this time of year, with Halloween coming soon.

We'd love to hear your thoughts on it!

Thanks for your support and best wishes.
The OutOfTheBit Team

notes.notes:
Hello friends of Super Arcade Racing!

You've voiced your desire for a windowed mode, and we're excited to announce that it's now available with our latest update! Easily switch to Full Screen with a quick press of F11 or ALT+CTRL. Plus, we've tweaked the points required for certain achievements.

notes.title: Split Screen Multiplayer Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35932058/88dc067ecf79be51202e86e0b414f717a4232288.png[/img]

We’re pleased to announce we have a new major update for Super Arcade Racing! (v1.03)

Here’s what’s new...
[list]
[*] [u][b]Split Screen[/b][/u]
Now you can play with up to 4 players locally. Each player can customise their car and choose their car upgrade (limited to whatever has been unlocked in the single player).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35932058/20c97969893287b672d8529f43b18a1c01a96685.png[/img]

[*] [u][b]Online levels[/b][/u]
We have added all the single player levels to the online multiplayer level selection options, giving you more levels to choose from (again, limited to whatever has been unlocked in the single player).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35932058/84796c586c97fef5b1ea3c7f78b3b5c4df0ed1c1.png[/img]


[*] [u][b]New Music[/b][/u]
We have added new music into the game! Each level will now have a song playing.

We have also added a [b][i]FREE DLC[/i][/b] of the soundtrack. And for those who want the megamix YouTube compilation, you can now listen to it all here:

[previewyoutube=vIHf-8HMu6Q;full][/previewyoutube]

If you have downloaded the DLC Soundtrack, you can find the .mp3 files here:
[list]
[*] In Steam, right click Super Arcade Racing
[*] Click ‘properties’
[*] Click ‘local files’ tab
[*] Click ‘Browse local files’
[*] There should be a folder called “Soundtrack”

Or alternatively, you can open up the steam overlay, click the music tab and see the Super Arcade Racing soundtrack there!
[/list]
[*] [u][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/u]
Minor bug fixes and improvements

[/list]

Thanks for playing, see you on the track!

- The OutOfTheBit Team
